term.value: Shopping Center Lease 11/12/2009; Initial Term commenced (Completion Date) 12/1/2009 with Rental Commencement 2/26/2010, running 120 full calendar months to an initial Expiration of 2/29/2020. FOUR 5-year options (affirmative exercise on ≥180 days' notice). Michaels has exercised options 1 and 2 (to 2/28/2030 — current), leaving two options (to 2040).

cite.doc: Lease BLP §4–5, Exhibit C §2.1–2.2; Notice of Lease; Renewal Notices

optionNotes: Four 5-year options (Exhibit C §2.2), each exercised by affirmative written notice ≥180 days before the then-current expiry (NOT auto-renewing; if Tenant misses, the right survives until 15 days after Landlord's notice of the failure). Rent steps $1.00/SF per option period. Options 1 and 2 exercised (2019 and 2024 notices); two remain at $14.50 and $15.50/SF.

rentSchedule.note: Rental Commencement through 60th full calendar month.

percentageRent.value: None. No percentage/overage rent (Gross Sales is referenced only to compute co-tenancy Alternative Rent).

exclusives.description: CRAFT-STORE exclusive (Exhibit C §16.4.1): no other space in the Center may be used as a craft store / arts-and-crafts, art supplies, craft supplies, picture frames or picture-framing services (framing is Michaels-exclusive), framed art, artificial flowers/plants & arrangements, wedding/party goods (except apparel), or scrapbooking/memory-book/papercrafting supplies — or any store similar to Michaels. Carve-outs: leases existing on the Effective Date (Exhibit I), and incidental sales ≤ the lesser of 1,000 SF or 10% of an occupant's floor (no incidental picture framing). Expressly permitted notwithstanding the exclusive: Kohl's; a full-line department store ≥80,000 SF (e.g. JCPenney); a home-improvement store ≥80,000 SF (Lowe's/Home Depot); a wholesale club (Sam's/Costco); a greeting-card store (Hallmark); a teacher-supply store; and a discount department store (TJ Maxx/Marshalls). Standard exclusive-overlap agreements with Bed Bath & Beyond and HomeGoods on request. Exclusive lapses if Michaels goes dark 12 months / 2 seasonal cycles.

coTenancy.value: ON-GOING CO-TENANCY (Exhibit C §16.3): at least 2 of the 3 named 'Other Required Lessees' — King Soopers (65,575 SF), OfficeMax (30,000 SF), PetSmart (15,250 SF) — must be open and operating as 'Anchor Tenants' (an Other Required Lessee, or a retailer with ≥20 stores nationally / ≥7 in CO + contiguous states; King Soopers replaceable by up to 3 tenants totaling ≥45,000 SF; OfficeMax/PetSmart by up to 2 tenants totaling ≥70% of their space). If <2 are operating: Minimum Rent abates and Michaels pays Alternative Rent (4% of Gross Sales, capped at Minimum Rent) — or, if Michaels is dark, Substitute Rent (50% of Minimum Rent). If the failure continues 18 consecutive months, Michaels may terminate on 60 days' notice (or Landlord may force a terminate-or-resume election).

camTax.value: CAM: pro rata (Premises SF ÷ total completed building SF), CAPPED at $3.20/SF in year one, with annual increases ≤5%/yr non-cumulative (excluding snow/ice, utilities and security). Excludes management fees, admin loads >10%, most capital, roof repairs, depreciation, vacant-space costs, leasing/marketing — very tenant-favorable. 2-year audit (3% overstatement → Landlord pays audit cost). Real Estate Taxes: pro rata (excl. separately-assessed pads), est. $3.13/SF year one, with reassessment protection (no pass-through of ownership-transfer reassessments more than once/5 yrs) and Tenant contest rights on >5% increases. Insurance: pro rata of Landlord's property + liability premiums, est. $0.32/SF year one. 18-month waiver if Landlord fails to bill.

leaseNotes.label: Security Deposit
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: Use Clause
leaseNotes.value: Retail use typical of a Michaels store (arts/crafts/home-décor/framing). No narrow permitted-use limit beyond the Prohibited Uses (Exhibit J) and applicable exclusives. No continuous-operation covenant — Michaels may cease operating (subject to the co-tenancy/exclusive go-dark mechanics).

leaseNotes.label: Radius
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: LL Radius
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: Craft-store exclusive (arts & crafts, art/craft supplies, picture frames/framing, framed art, artificial florals, wedding/party goods ex-apparel, scrapbooking/papercrafting). Picture framing is exclusively Michaels. Carve-outs for Exhibit I existing leases and incidental ≤1,000 SF/10%. Permitted: Kohl's, ≥80k full-line dept store, ≥80k home-improvement, wholesale club, greeting-card store, teacher-supply, off-price dept store (TJ Maxx/Marshalls). Lapses on 12-month go-dark.

leaseNotes.label: Co-tenancy
leaseNotes.value: Requires 2 of 3 anchors (King Soopers, OfficeMax, PetSmart) operating. If <2: Alternative Rent (4% of sales, ≤ Minimum Rent) or Substitute Rent (50% of Minimum Rent if dark); 18-month failure → Tenant 60-day termination right (or Landlord terminate-or-resume election). See the co-tenancy review flag below — the OfficeMax box appears no longer operating.

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (LL)
leaseNotes.value: Landlord casualty termination if ≥50% of Center/Premises destroyed (only if substantially all leases likewise terminated); exclusive/co-tenancy terminate-or-resume elections; recapture on certain assignments.

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (Tenant)
leaseNotes.value: Tenant termination on: 18-month co-tenancy failure (§16.3); uncured exclusive violation after the abatement ladder (§16.4.2); casualty per §12; condemnation per §13; and uncured Landlord default materially affecting use/quiet enjoyment (§14.2).

leaseNotes.label: LL Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Landlord (and entities it controls) may not use/lease/sell Center space for the Michaels craft exclusive (§16.4.1) or for the 'Michaels Prohibited Uses' / 'Other Prohibited Uses' on Exhibit J (§16.5). Landlord must enforce (commence suit within 45 days of a violation). Landlord may not encumber the Center with restrictions that raise Tenant's costs or materially harm its business (§8.4).

leaseNotes.label: Tenant Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Tenant may not use the Premises for any 'Michaels Prohibited Uses' or effective 'Other Prohibited Uses' on Exhibit J (§16.5), nor (for assignees/sublessees) violate exclusives of anchor tenants existing or future-qualifying under §11.

leaseNotes.label: CAM Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro rata (Premises SF ÷ total completed building SF). CAP: ≤$3.20/SF year one, then ≤5%/yr non-cumulative (excl. snow/ice, utilities, security). Excludes management fees, admin >10%, capital (except savings-amortized items), roof repairs, depreciation, vacant-space, leasing costs. Annual reconciliation by May 1; 2-year audit (3% overstatement → LL pays audit up to $2,500). 18-month billing waiver.

leaseNotes.label: Tax Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro rata of Center Real Estate Taxes (Premises SF ÷ total completed building SF, excl. separately-assessed pads/out-parcels). Est. $3.13/SF year one. Excludes transfer/franchise/income taxes and (generally) ownership-transfer reassessment increases more than once/5 yrs. Tenant contest rights on >5% increases; refunds shared. 18-month billing waiver.

leaseNotes.label: Insurance Method
leaseNotes.value: Tenant pays pro rata share of Landlord's property (§5.2.1) and liability (§5.2.2) insurance premiums, est. $0.32/SF year one, billed with CAM. 18-month billing waiver.

leaseNotes.label: Assignment & Sublet
leaseNotes.value: Tenant may assign/sublet WITHOUT Landlord consent (if not in monetary default), provided the use doesn't violate the Prohibited Uses (§16.5/16.6) or a qualifying anchor's Future Exclusive. Free transfers to Affiliates (incl. merger/consolidation/50%+ acquisition). Subdividing into >2 premises (one ≥15,000 SF) needs consent. Landlord RECAPTURE right (30-day) on assignment/sublet to a non-Anchor, non-Affiliate (Tenant may nullify by withdrawing). Tenant remains primarily liable except on permitted Affiliate/3+-location transfers.

leaseNotes.label: Alterations
leaseNotes.value: Structural/exterior alterations need Landlord consent (not unreasonably withheld); interior non-structural alterations are at Tenant's discretion (notice if cost >$30,000). Tenant trade fixtures/equipment remain Tenant's and are removable; other improvements become Landlord's at expiry.

leaseNotes.label: Operating Covenant
leaseNotes.value: None — no continuous-operation requirement (co-tenancy and exclusive provisions contemplate Tenant going dark).

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option
leaseNotes.value: Tenant may go dark (no continuous-operation covenant). Consequences: the craft exclusive lapses after 12 months dark / 2 seasonal cycles (§16.4.1); and going dark interacts with the co-tenancy rent formula (Substitute Rent 50% if dark during a co-tenancy failure). No landlord recapture purely for going dark.

leaseNotes.label: Default
leaseNotes.value: Tenant monetary default: 10 days after written notice (§14.1(i)). Non-monetary: 30 days after notice (longer if not curable in 30 and Tenant diligently pursues). On default, Landlord may terminate the lease or possession, or cure for Tenant; interest at the Interest Rate; Landlord must mitigate/relet. Landlord default (§14.2): 30-day cure; Tenant self-help/offset capped at 25% of each Minimum Rent (and 25% of CAM for common-area cures).

leaseNotes.label: Guaranty
leaseNotes.value: None — Michaels Stores, Inc. (Delaware) is the tenant; no separate guaranty.

leaseNotes.label: Outparcel Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Center has out-parcels/pads; separately-assessed pads excluded from the CAM/tax denominator. Parking ratio ≥4.5/1,000 SF maintained; 'Critical Area' parking on Exhibit B may not be reduced.

leaseNotes.label: Purchase Option / ROFR
leaseNotes.value: None — Right of First Refusal (§2.5) and end-of-term purchase option (§2.6) are both 'Intentionally Deleted'.

leaseNotes.label: Holdover
leaseNotes.value: Month-to-month at the prior 12 months' Minimum Rent; either party may terminate on 30 days' notice. If Tenant fails to vacate after Landlord's termination notice, holdover Minimum Rent steps to 125% of the prior rate.

leaseNotes.label: Relocation
leaseNotes.value: None — no landlord relocation right; building/critical-area parking fixed on Exhibit B.

leaseNotes.label: Utilities
leaseNotes.value: Separately metered; Tenant pays utilities directly to providers based on consumption. Water/sewer is sub-metered (First Amendment) and billed by Landlord at no more than prevailing utility rates.

leaseNotes.label: HVAC / Maintenance
leaseNotes.value: Tenant maintains the interior/non-structural Premises and its HVAC. Landlord maintains the structure, roof and Common Areas (roof repairs are excluded from CAM). Capital items and roof are largely Landlord's cost.

leaseNotes.label: Pylon / Signage
leaseNotes.value: Building signage (Landlord consent not unreasonably withheld) plus pylon/monument sign rights per the Sign Rendering exhibits (F / F-1). Landlord maintains and lights the pylon/monument signs.

cite.section: Exhibit C §7; BLP Exhibits F, F-1

leaseNotes.label: Subordination / SNDA
leaseNotes.value: Tenant subordinates to Landlord's mortgagee ONLY upon a non-disturbance agreement (Exhibit G): possession undisturbed absent default, lease survives foreclosure, purchaser bound. Landlord owed SNDAs within 60 days of the Effective Date (Tenant termination right if not delivered). Landlord waives statutory/contractual liens on Tenant's property.

leaseNotes.label: Estoppel
leaseNotes.value: Customary estoppel/SNDA cooperation; if Landlord requests >1 subordination agreement per 6-month period, Landlord reimburses Tenant's review cost up to $500.

flags.issue: Co-tenancy depends on a SHORT-TERM OfficeMax — drops to 2 of 3 with no cushion when OfficeMax leaves
flags.detail: Michaels' co-tenancy (§16.3) requires 2 of 3 named anchors operating: King Soopers, OfficeMax (30,000 SF), PetSmart. King Soopers (65,575) and PetSmart (15,250) are operating. OfficeMax/Office Depot is also still in possession (16,724 SF under its 2015 Amended & Restated Lease) but is on a confirmed EXIT track: it DECLINED renewal (Non-Renewal Notice 3/14/2025) and is on a 1-year KPR extension to 9/30/2026 that EITHER party can end on 120–150 days' notice (KPR is marketing the space). Because OfficeMax is itself a named anchor, that presence keeps the count at 3 of 3 for now, BUT its departure is imminent: when OfficeMax leaves (≤9/30/2026, possibly sooner), Michaels falls to exactly 2 of 3 (King Soopers + PetSmart) with zero cushion — at which point a dark King Soopers or PetSmart would breach co-tenancy (Alternative Rent at 4% of sales, then an 18-month termination right). Track OfficeMax's departure; note a REPLACEMENT for the OfficeMax leg would need to be an 'Anchor Tenant' (≥20 stores nationally / ≥7 regionally, or up to 2 tenants filling ≥70% (≈21,000 SF) of the OfficeMax space). KPR should track this.

flags.issue: Abstract reconciles cleanly with the rent roll
flags.detail: Full document chain read (lease + 2 amendments + 2 global pickup-parking letters + commencement agreement + 2019 & 2024 option-exercise notices). Rent ladder $10.50→$15.50/SF and the four 5-year options match the Basic Lease Provisions and both renewal notices; current rent $13.50/SF ($437,886/yr) through 2/28/2030 matches the rent roll. No discrepancies. No Third Amendment exists in the folder (full folder enumerated by ID).

narrative: Michaels (Michaels Stores, Inc.; store #9183) occupies 32,436 SF (Suite 55) at University Hills, Denver under an 11/12/2009 shopping-center lease (rent commenced 2/26/2010). The initial 10-year term ran to 2/29/2020; Michaels has since exercised two of its four 5-year options (via 2019 and 2024 notices), so the current term runs to 2/28/2030 at $13.50/SF ($437,886/yr), with two options remaining at $14.50 and $15.50/SF (to 2040). Rent steps $1.00/SF per period; there is no percentage rent and no guaranty (Michaels Stores, Inc. is the tenant). The lease carries a broad craft-store exclusive (including exclusive picture framing) that lapses only on a 12-month go-dark, a tenant-favorable CAM cap ($3.20/SF then ≤4%... ≤5%/yr non-cumulative, no management/capital/roof), reassessment-protected taxes, free assignment subject to a landlord recapture right for non-anchors, and no purchase option (ROFR deleted). The key watch item is co-tenancy: §16.3 requires 2 of 3 anchors (King Soopers, OfficeMax, PetSmart), and with the 30,000 SF OfficeMax box no longer operating as a retail anchor (now a small Office Depot + goPuff), Michaels sits at exactly 2 of 3 with no cushion — flagged for KPR. The full document folder was enumerated and read; the abstract reconciles cleanly with the April-2026 rent roll with no discrepancies and no missing amendment.
